_about: The intro phase (sim/core/intro.gd plays it; sim/director/intro.gd picks it; docs/architecture/intro-phase.md; Narrative's scenarios in docs/narrative/dynamic-intros.md). Pre-clock ticks at the start of a match that asks for it. A template is a scenario: an ordered list of slots, each filled by one part from its pool. A part is a short list of beats with ticks from the part's start. Ticks are sim ticks, 60 a second. Roles: first and second by arrival; left and right by start spot; both. Every template ends in the same state: both fighters standing on their start spots, each in his entrance crater.
_skipFrom: a press on a human slot skips from this tick on
_fall: fallHeight: units above the ground a fall starts from. craterEnergy: the entrance crater's energy (World's crater scale; 0 digs none)

parts._note: type: entrance (it has one fall at 0 and one land at its last tick), reaction or look. ticks: how far the part moves the template on. mode: the arrival mode an entrance reports. Beat kinds: fall, land, wait (he stands waiting until the staredown), line (a voice slot: the intent only), staredown. A beat's who overrides its slot's.

templates._note: Narrative's S1, and the opening the game had before: first falls and lands, second falls and lands, they stare. classic: it is what a plain "intro": true plays, the left spot first, at the default gap
Narrative's S2: first lands and waits; second arrives late. The gap is the wait
Narrative's S9: the double drop with a long, silent stare. notTwice: never right after itself; its weight keeps it to one in six
